:::{.list-table}

- - Categorical Concept
  - Field Galois Theory  
    ($L/K$)
  - Hilbert's Nullstellensatz  
    ($k[x_1,\dots,x_n]$)
  - Grothendieck's Scheme Theory
  - Covering Space Theory  
    ($\text{Cov}(X)$)
  - Pointless Topology (Locales)
  - Stone Duality  
    (Boolean $\leftrightarrow$ Stone)
  - Functional Analysis (Banach Duals)
  - Convex Geometry (Polar Polytopes)
  - Pontryagin Duality (LCA Groups)

- - **Dualizing Object  
    $\Omega$ & Pairing**
  - Ambient field  
    $L$ via action $\sigma(x)=x$
  - Field  
    $k$ via evaluation $f(x)=0$
  - Affine line scheme  
    $\mathbb{A}^1_{\mathbb{Z}} = \text{Spec}(\mathbb{Z}[t])$
  - Universal cover  
    $\widetilde{X}$ as a $\pi_1(X)$-torsor
  - Sierpiński space  
    $\{0,1\}$ (open/closed point)
  - Discrete 2-point space  
    $\mathbf{2}=\{0,1\}$
  - Scalar field  
    $\mathbb{R}/\mathbb{C}$ via $\langle \varphi, x \rangle = 0$
  - Bound  
    $\mathbb{R}$ via inequality $\langle x,y \rangle \le 1$
  - Circle group  
    $S^1 = \mathbb{R}/\mathbb{Z}$ via $\chi(g) = 1$

- - **Category  
    $\mathcal{C}$**
  - Intermediate fields  
    $K \subseteq E \subseteq L$ ($\subseteq$)
  - Ideals  
    $J \subseteq R$ ($\subseteq$)
  - Commutative Rings  
    $\mathbf{CRing}$
  - Covering spaces  
    $\text{Cov}(X)$ over $X$
  - Topological Spaces  
    $\mathbf{Top}$
  - Stone Spaces  
    $\mathbf{Stone}$ (or $\mathbf{Top}$)
  - Subspaces  
    $Y \subseteq X$ of Banach space ($\subseteq$)
  - Euclidean subsets  
    $A \subseteq \mathbb{R}^n$ ($\subseteq$)
  - Subgroups  
    $H \le G$ of LCA group ($\subseteq$)

- - **Category  
    $\mathcal{D}$**
  - Subgroups  
    $H \le G$ ($\supseteq$)
  - Variety subsets  
    $S \subseteq \mathbb{A}^n_k$ ($\supseteq$)
  - Locally Ringed Spaces  
    $\mathbf{LRS}^{\text{op}}$
  - $\pi_1(X, x_0)$-Sets
  - Locales  
    $\mathbf{Loc} = \mathbf{Frm}^{\text{op}}$
  - Opposite of Booleans  
    $\mathbf{Bool}^{\text{op}}$
  - Dual subspaces  
    $W \subseteq X^*$ ($\supseteq$)
  - Dual subsets  
    $B \subseteq (\mathbb{R}^n)^*$ ($\supseteq$)
  - Dual subgroups  
    $\Lambda \le \widehat{G}$ ($\supseteq$)

- - **Morphism in  
    $\mathcal{C}$**
  - Field inclusion  
    $E_1 \subseteq E_2$
  - Ideal inclusion  
    $J_1 \subseteq J_2$
  - Ring homomorphism  
    $\varphi: R \to S$
  - Continuous map of covers  
    $E_1 \to E_2$
  - Continuous map  
    $f: X \to Y$
  - Continuous map  
    $f: X \to Y$
  - Subspace inclusion  
    $Y_1 \subseteq Y_2$
  - Subset inclusion  
    $A_1 \subseteq A_2$
  - Subgroup inclusion  
    $H_1 \subseteq H_2$

- - **Morphism in  
    $\mathcal{D}$**
  - Subgroup containment  
    $H_1 \supseteq H_2$
  - Subset containment  
    $S_1 \supseteq S_2$
  - Morphism  
    $(Y, \mathcal{O}_Y) \to (X, \mathcal{O}_X)$
  - $\pi_1$-equivariant map $S_1 \to S_2$
  - Frame map  
    $L_2 \to L_1$ (preimages)
  - Boolean map  
    $B_2 \to B_1$
  - Dual containment  
    $W_1 \supseteq W_2$
  - Dual containment  
    $B_1 \supseteq B_2$
  - Dual containment  
    $\Lambda_1 \supseteq \Lambda_2$

- - **Left Adjoint  
    $F: \mathcal{C} \to \mathcal{D}$**
  - Galois group  
    $\text{Gal}(L/E)$
  - Vanishing locus  
    $\mathbb{V}(J)$
  - Spectrum functor  
    $\text{Spec}(R)$
  - Fiber functor  
    $\text{Fib}_{x_0}: E \mapsto p^{-1}(x_0)$
  - Open-set frame  
    $\mathcal{O}(X)$
  - Clopen algebra  
    $\text{Clopen}(X)$
  - Annihilator  
    $Y^\perp$
  - Polar set  
    $A^\circ = \{y \mid \langle x,y \rangle \le 1\}$
  - Annihilator  
    $H^\perp = \{\chi \mid \chi\vert{}_H = 1\}$

- - **Right Adjoint  
    $G: \mathcal{D} \to \mathcal{C}$**
  - Fixed field  
    $L^H$
  - Vanishing ideal  
    $\mathbb{I}(S)$
  - Global sections  
    $\Gamma(X, \mathcal{O}_X)$
  - Associated bundle  
    $(\widetilde{X} \times S)/\pi_1(X)$
  - Point spectrum  
    $\text{pt}(L)$
  - Ultrafilter space  
    $\text{Ult}(B)$
  - Pre-annihilator  
    ${}^\perp W$
  - Polar set  
    $B^\circ = \{x \mid \langle x,y \rangle \le 1\}$
  - Inverse annihilator  
    ${}^\perp \Lambda$

- - **Hom-Set Bijection**  
    $\text{Hom}_{\mathcal{D}}(F(c),d) \cong \text{Hom}_{\mathcal{C}}(c,G(d))$
  - $H \subseteq \text{Gal}(L/E) \iff E \subseteq L^H$
  - $S \subseteq \mathbb{V}(J) \iff J \subseteq \mathbb{I}(S)$
  - $\text{Hom}_{\mathbf{LRS}}(X, \text{Spec}(R)) \cong \text{Hom}(R, \Gamma(X))$
  - $\text{Hom}_{\pi_1}(p^{-1}(x_0), S) \cong \text{Hom}(E, \widetilde{X} \times_{\pi_1} S)$
  - $\text{Hom}(L, \mathcal{O}(X)) \cong \text{Hom}(X, \text{pt}(L))$
  - $\text{Hom}(B, \text{Clopen}(X)) \cong \text{Hom}(X, \text{Ult}(B))$
  - $W \subseteq Y^\perp \iff Y \subseteq {}^\perp W$
  - $B \subseteq A^\circ \iff A \subseteq B^\circ$
  - $\Lambda \subseteq H^\perp \iff H \subseteq {}^\perp \Lambda$

- - **Monad  
    $T = GF$**
  - Subfield Galois closure  
    $E \mapsto L^{\text{Gal}(L/E)}$
  - Radical ideal  
    $J \mapsto \mathbb{I}(\mathbb{V}(J)) = \sqrt{J}$
  - Identity functor  
    $\text{Id}_{\mathbf{CRing}}$ ($R \cong \Gamma(\text{Spec} R)$)
  - Identity functor  
    $\text{Id}_{\text{Cov}(X)}$
  - Soberification  
    $X \mapsto \text{pt}(\mathcal{O}(X))$
  - Stone–Čech completion  
    $X \mapsto \text{Ult}(\text{Clopen} X)$
  - Norm-closure of span  
    $\overline{\text{span}(Y)}^{\Vert{}\cdot\Vert{}}$
  - Closed convex hull with $0$:  
    $A^{\circ\circ}$
  - Topological closure  
    $\overline{H}$ in $G$

- - **Unit  
    $\text{Id}_{\mathcal{C}} \xrightarrow{\eta} T = GF$**
  - Field inclusion  
    $E \subseteq L^{\text{Gal}(L/E)}$
  - Ideal inclusion  
    $J \subseteq \sqrt{J}$
  - Canonical isomorphism  
    $R \stackrel{\sim}{\to} \Gamma(\text{Spec} R)$
  - Canonical map  
    $E \stackrel{\sim}{\to} \widetilde{X} \times_{\pi_1} p^{-1}(x_0)$
  - Canonical map  
    $x \mapsto \mathcal{O}_x$ to $\text{pt}(\mathcal{O}(X))$
  - Canonical evaluation map  
    $X \to \text{Ult}(\text{Clopen}(X))$
  - Subspace inclusion  
    $Y \subseteq {}^\perp(Y^\perp)$
  - Hull inclusion  
    $A \subseteq A^{\circ\circ}$
  - Subgroup inclusion  
    $H \subseteq \overline{H}$

- - **Comonad  
    $W = FG$**
  - Krull subgroup closure  
    $H \mapsto \text{Gal}(L/L^H)$
  - Zariski closure  
    $S \mapsto \mathbb{V}(\mathbb{I}(S)) = \overline{S}^{\text{Zar}}$
  - Affinization  
    $(X, \mathcal{O}_X) \mapsto \text{Spec}(\Gamma(X))$
  - Identity functor  
    $\text{Id}_{\pi_1\text{-Set}}$
  - Spatialization  
    $L \mapsto \mathcal{O}(\text{pt}(L))$
  - Identity functor  
    $\text{Id}_{\mathbf{Bool}^{\text{op}}}$
  - Weak$^*$-closure of span  
    $\overline{\text{span}(W)}^{w^*}$
  - Closed convex hull with $0$:  
    $B^{\circ\circ}$
  - Topological closure  
    $\overline{\Lambda}$ in $\widehat{G}$

- - **Counit  
    $W = FG \xrightarrow{\varepsilon} \text{Id}_{\mathcal{D}}$**
  - Subgroup inclusion  
    $\text{Gal}(L/L^H) \supseteq H$
  - Subset inclusion  
    $\overline{S}^{\text{Zar}} \supseteq S$
  - Canonical map  
    $X \to \text{Spec}(\Gamma(X))$
  - Canonical isomorphism  
    $p^{-1}(x_0) \stackrel{\sim}{\to} S$
  - Frame map  
    $u \mapsto \{p \mid u \in p\}$
  - Stone isomorphism  
    $B \stackrel{\sim}{\to} \text{Clopen}(\text{Ult}(B))$
  - Weak$^*$-inclusion  
    $({}^\perp W)^\perp \supseteq W$
  - Dual hull inclusion  
    $B^{\circ\circ} \supseteq B$
  - Dual subgroup inclusion  
    $\overline{\Lambda} \supseteq \Lambda$

- - **Triangle Identities**  
    $F \xrightarrow{F\eta} FGF \xrightarrow{\varepsilon F} F$  
    $G \xrightarrow{\eta G} GFG \xrightarrow{G\varepsilon} G$  
    Both composites are identities
  - $\text{Gal}(L/L^{\text{Gal}(L/E)}) = \text{Gal}(L/E)$
  - $\mathbb{V}(\mathbb{I}(\mathbb{V}(J))) = \mathbb{V}(J)$
  - $\Gamma(\text{Spec}(\Gamma(X))) \cong \Gamma(X)$
  - Adjunction triangle identities hold
  - $\mathcal{O}(\text{pt}(\mathcal{O}(X))) \cong \mathcal{O}(X)$
  - $\text{Clopen}(\text{Ult}(\text{Clopen} X)) \cong \text{Clopen} X$
  - $({}^\perp(Y^\perp))^\perp = Y^\perp$
  - $A^{\circ\circ\circ} = A^\circ$ and $B^{\circ\circ\circ} = B^\circ$
  - $({}^\perp(H^\perp))^\perp = H^\perp$

- - **Eilenberg–Moore  
    $\mathcal{C}^T$ (Fixed Points)**
  - **Galois-Closed Fields**  
    ($L^{\text{Gal}(L/E)} = E$)
  - **Radical Ideals**  
    ($\sqrt{J} = J$)
  - **All Commutative Rings**  
    $\mathbf{CRing}$
  - **All Covering Spaces**  
    $\text{Cov}(X)$
  - **Sober Spaces  
    $\mathbf{Sob}$**
  - **Stone Spaces  
    $\mathbf{Stone}$**
  - **Norm-Closed Subspaces** of  
    $X$
  - **Closed Convex Sets** with  
    $0 \in A$
  - **Closed Subgroups** of  
    $G$

- - **Co-Eilenberg–Moore  
    $\mathcal{D}_W$ (Fixed Points)**
  - **Closed Subgroups** in Krull topology
  - **Affine Varieties**  
    ($\overline{V}^{\text{Zar}} = V$)
  - **Affine Schemes  
    $\mathbf{AffSch}^{\text{op}}$**
  - **All  
    $\pi_1(X, x_0)$-Sets**
  - **Spatial Locales  
    $\mathbf{SpatLoc}$**
  - **All Boolean Algebras  
    $\mathbf{Bool}^{\text{op}}$**
  - **Weak$^*$-Closed Subspaces** of  
    $X^*$
  - **Closed Convex Sets** with  
    $0 \in B$
  - **Closed Subgroups** of  
    $\widehat{G}$

- - **Restricted Equivalence  
    $\mathcal{C}^T \simeq \mathcal{D}_W$**
  - **Fundamental Theorem of Galois Theory**
  - **Hilbert's Nullstellensatz**
  - **Grothendieck Equivalence**  
    ($\mathbf{CRing} \simeq \mathbf{AffSch}^{\text{op}}$)
  - **Poincaré–Grothendieck Equivalence**
  - **Isbell Duality**  
    ($\mathbf{Sob} \simeq \mathbf{SpatLoc}$)
  - **Stone's Representation Theorem**
  - **Hahn–Banach Duality**
  - **Minkowski Bipolar / Farkas Lemma**
  - **Pontryagin Subgroup Duality**

- - **LAPC / Colimit Preservation**  
    $F(\operatorname{colim}_i c_i) \cong \operatorname{colim}_i F(c_i)$
  - $\text{Gal}(L/E_1 E_2) = \text{Gal}(L/E_1) \cap \text{Gal}(L/E_2)$
  - $\mathbb{V}(J_1 + J_2) = \mathbb{V}(J_1) \cap \mathbb{V}(J_2)$
  - $R \otimes_A S \longleftrightarrow \text{Spec} R \times_{\text{Spec} A} \text{Spec} S$
  - Coproduct of covers  
    $\longleftrightarrow$ Disjoint union of fibers
  - $\coprod X_i \mapsto \prod \mathcal{O}(X_i)$
  - Disjoint union of spaces  
    $\leftrightarrow$ Product of algebras
  - $(Y_1 + Y_2)^\perp = Y_1^\perp \cap Y_2^\perp$
  - $(A_1 \cup A_2)^\circ = A_1^\circ \cap A_2^\circ$
  - $\overline{H_1 H_2}^\perp = H_1^\perp \cap H_2^\perp$

- - **RAPL / Limit Preservation**  
    $G(\lim_i d_i) \cong \lim_i G(d_i)$
  - $L^{\langle H_1, H_2 \rangle} = L^{H_1} \cap L^{H_2}$
  - $\mathbb{I}(S_1 \cup S_2) = \mathbb{I}(S_1) \cap \mathbb{I}(S_2)$
  - Global sections of glued schemes = Pullback of rings
  - Fiber product of covers  
    $\longleftrightarrow$ Pullback of $\pi_1$-sets
  - Limit of spaces  
    $\longleftrightarrow$ Colimit of frames
  - Colimit of spaces  
    $\longleftrightarrow$ Limit of algebras
  - ${}^\perp(W_1 + W_2) = {}^\perp W_1 \cap {}^\perp W_2$
  - $\overline{\text{conv}}(B_1 \cup B_2)^\circ = B_1^\circ \cap B_2^\circ$
  - ${}^\perp(\overline{\Lambda_1 \Lambda_2}) = {}^\perp \Lambda_1 \cap {}^\perp \Lambda_2$

- - **Initial / Terminal Duality**  
    $F(0_{\mathcal{C}}) \cong 0_{\mathcal{D}}$  
    $G(1_{\mathcal{D}}) \cong 1_{\mathcal{C}}$
  - $K \mapsto G$, $\{e\} \mapsto L$
  - $(0) \mapsto \mathbb{A}^n_k$, $\emptyset \mapsto R=(1)$
  - $\mathbb{Z} \mapsto \text{Spec}(\mathbb{Z})$, $\{0\} \mapsto \emptyset$
  - $X \leftrightarrow \{*\}$, $\widetilde{X} \leftrightarrow \pi_1(X)$
  - $\emptyset \leftrightarrow \{0=1\}$, $\{*\} \leftrightarrow \{0,1\}$
  - $\emptyset \leftrightarrow \{0=1\}$, $\{*\} \leftrightarrow \mathbf{2}$
  - $\{0\} \mapsto X^*$, $\{0\} \mapsto X$
  - $\{0\} \mapsto (\mathbb{R}^n)^*$, $\{0\} \mapsto \mathbb{R}^n$
  - $\{e\} \mapsto \widehat{G}$, $\{1\} \mapsto G$

:::
